cc-app--denied: page-variant marker on #app-content.cc-app root (denied surface); nav-less full-span owned by app.css :not(:has(>#app-navigation)) grid guard
cc-audit: audit page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); JS binds by id, layout via .cc-panel/.cc-table
cc-col-cost: JS hook toggling yearly-cost column visibility (js/pages/contracts.js)
cc-contract-detail: page-detect hook + region marker; contract.js dispatches detail vs form on this class
cc-contract-form: page-detect hook + region marker; contract.js dispatches form vs detail on this class
cc-contracts: contract-list page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); JS binds by id
cc-dashboard: dashboard page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); page chrome via cc-app--dashboard scope variant
cc-import: import page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); result block styled via .cc-import-result
cc-parties: parties page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); JS binds by id
cc-picker__input: picker element marker on styled .cc-input; combobox chrome owned by .cc-picker block (initPicker binds element refs, not the class)
cc-reports: reports page section scope marker (aria-labelledby region); JS binds by id
cc-settings: settings page mount hook (js/pages/settings.js querySelector) + region marker
cc-table__row: row marker emitted on generated <tr> (js/pages/contracts.js); zebra/hover owned by .cc-table tbody tr rules
cc-transfer-report: transfer report dialog variant marker on styled .cc-dialog
